scope: SNU GSPA first-cohort reconstruction and the No Yung-hee 1958-08 chronology anomaly

findings.claim: SNU's official GSPA yearbook/history states that the school was established inside the College of Law in January 1959, produced its first 80 MPA graduates in March 1961, and was separated from the College of Law in the same month.
findings.implication: The first cohort is a bounded 80-person population and March 1961 graduation plus administrative separation remain distinct sub-events.

findings.claim: A 1969 article by Park Dong-seo in SNU GSPA's own Korean Journal of Public Administration explicitly reviews the preceding ten years of graduate education and divides the inquiry into admissions, curriculum and student guidance.
findings.provenance: SNU Open Repository and Archive, Park Dong-seo, '교육내용', 행정논총 7(1), 1969, pp.27-46
findings.implication: This is a high-value near-contemporaneous source for reconstructing the 1959 intake and curriculum even before the admission register is recovered. The PDF tables/pages should be extracted next.

findings.claim: Oh Seok-hong's 2009 autobiographical essay states that GSPA was founded in the year he graduated from SNU Law, that he entered when it was founded, and that he became a member of its first graduating class.
findings.provenance: SNU Emeritus Professors Association newsletter No.5 (2009), '학자의 생애', Oh Seok-hong
findings.implication: Oh Seok-hong is independently anchored as a first-cohort member by first-person testimony, but the complete roster still requires the official register.

findings.claim: Korea University's official profile records Paik Wan-ki graduating SNU Political Science in 1959 and SNU GSPA with an MPA in 1961.
findings.provenance: Korea University Institute for Government Studies official profile
findings.implication: Paik Wan-ki remains an independently verified first-cohort candidate.

findings.claim: Multiple biographical sources record Kang Shin-taek graduating SNU Political Science in 1959 and receiving an SNU public-administration master's degree in 1961.
findings.implication: Kang Shin-taek is a strong first-cohort candidate, but a primary SNU register is still needed before treating cohort membership as fully verified.

findings.claim: KRIHS's official 2021 exhibition booklet for No Yung-hee records his SNU GSPA professorship as beginning in August 1958, months before the January 1959 institutional founding convention.
findings.provenance: Korea Research Institute for Human Settlements official exhibition booklet, 2021
findings.implication: The chronology anomaly is now confirmed as an official-institution biography claim rather than a search-snippet artifact. It must remain CONFLICTED/NARROWED until an appointment order identifies the employing unit and retroactive labeling, if any.

findings.claim: No Yung-hee published a 1960 review through the SNU Law Research Institute, and SNU's repository classifies that item under the College of Law/Law School collection.
findings.provenance: SNU Open Repository and Archive, 법학 Vol.2 No.2 (1960)
findings.implication: This supplies a concrete Law College institutional trace close to the disputed period and strengthens the hypothesis that later biographies may have normalized an earlier Law College appointment into a GSPA career span. It does not itself prove the hypothesis.

findings.claim: A January 2026 obituary identifies Yu Hun as a founding GSPA professor, serving there from 1959 to 1994, and records that he passed the fifth higher civil-service examination in 1953.
findings.implication: Yu Hun is a founding faculty node with prior state-examination experience, but this alone does not make him a political actor or establish decree authorship.

adversarial_checks: Do not infer all 80 first graduates entered on the same date or through the same admissions channel.
Do not treat first-person first-cohort testimony as a substitute for the complete official roster.
Do not treat 1961 MPA dates alone as conclusive first-cohort proof where entry date is absent.
Do not silently correct KRIHS's official 1958-08 No Yung-hee date to 1959 merely because GSPA's legal creation came later.
Do not infer that No Yung-hee was legally employed by a nonexistent independent GSPA in August 1958.
Do not infer from a 1960 Law Research Institute publication that No Yung-hee's 1958 appointment was necessarily to Law College; obtain the personnel order.
Do not infer policy authorship from founding-faculty status.
Do not classify academics as politicians solely because they advised government or sat on later committees.
Do not collapse March 1961 first graduation and March 1961 separation into one event without exact dates/instruments.
Do not use later commemorative histories as substitutes for contemporaneous personnel, admissions, curriculum and organization records.
